ارتعفتن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَفْتُنَّ (irtaʕaftunna) /ir.ta.ʕaf.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اُرْتُعِفْتُنَّ (urtuʕiftunna) /ur.tu.ʕif.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
